sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains two interpretations of the term "Source of Life" (Makor Chayim) and how they correspond to two interpretations of the verse "For with You is the source of life."

translations.translation: Now, in order to explain the superiority of length (orech),
through which the greatness of the light that is seen through length will be understood
(which is above even length),
this will be understood by prefacing the explanation of the aspect of the Source of Life (Makor Chayim),
which has two interpretations.
For that which is called by the name "Source of Life" is,
that even the surrounding light (Or HaSovev),
since it is merely an illumination,
is a source
(at least)
(for the light that fills and through this,
also)
for the vitality that is invested in the worlds.
And that "Source of Life" refers to the light that is above the aspect of a source for the vitality of Memaleh Kol Almin,
and this that it is called by the name "Source of Life" is because from it vitality is found
[similar to what is said in Likkutei Torah,
regarding the matter that the Holy One, blessed be He, is called "our Rock of Life" (Tzur Chayeinu),
that the explanation of "Rock" (Tzur) is the source and root of all roots of coming-into-being,
for the intention is not that He is a source, heaven forbid, for coming-into-being,
but rather that all roots of coming-into-being are found from Him].
And this is what is said, "For with You is the source of life,"
for in the word "with You" (imcha) there are two interpretations.
That the emphasis in "with You" is that it is only "with You" and not You,
a thing that is secondary and nullified to You.
And that the emphasis in "with You" is that it is not a matter unto itself, but rather "with You,"
unified with Him, blessed be He.
And similar to what is said in the Midrash
on the verse,
"If you lend money to My people,"
"If you lend money... to My people,"
"Just as I... so too you..."
And it can be said,
that these two interpretations correspond to the two interpretations
(above)
regarding the Source of Life.
For according to the interpretation that the Source of Life is the aspect of a source for life,
the interpretation of "For with You is the source of life" is that the matter of the Source of Life is only "with You" and not You,
secondary and nullified to You.
And according to the interpretation that the Source of Life is that life is found from Him
(but not that He is the aspect of a source),
the interpretation of "For with You is the source of life" is that the drawing down of life is only from "with You,"
from the aspect of the light that is unified with Him, blessed be He.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that "length" (orech) is above any connection to worlds, being the light included in His Essence, which is like His Name alone before the tzimtzum.

translations.translation: Now, even according to the interpretation that the intention in "Source of Life" is that from Him life is found
(and not that He is in the aspect of a source for them),
nevertheless,
from the fact that it is called by the name "Source of Life"
(the vitality of the worlds),
it is proven that it has a connection to the worlds.
And this is why, after it says "For with You is the source of life," it adds "in Your light" etc.
(for the order of matters in the verse is from below to above,
as above),
for "length" (orech) is above connection to worlds.
And therefore it is called by the name "light"
(length),
for the matter of light is that it is attached to the luminary and is of the same essence as the luminary.
That is,
that it is not in the aspect of existence,
and consequently it cannot be a source for anything,
and its entire matter is that it is a revelation of the luminary.
And it specifies "in Your light" (be-orcha),
for in addition to this that light in general
(even as it spreads outside the luminary)
its entire matter is the spreading and revelation of the luminary as above,
nevertheless, within light itself, it is "Your light,"
light of Yours,
light that is included in His Essence.
For in general, this is the Ein Sof light that is before the tzimtzum
(as explained in many places
that the general light before the tzimtzum is the light included in His Essence).
For this light is above connection to worlds,
and therefore,
in order for the coming-into-being of the worlds to occur, there must be a removal of the light.
And about this our Sages said,
"Before the world was created, He and His Name alone existed,"
for the light before the tzimtzum
(for the beginning of creation is the tzimtzum,
and "before the world was created" refers to before the tzimtzum)
is called His Name,
for just as a person's name is not an existence at all
(not even like the existence of light)
and its entire matter is that the person turns to those who call him by his name,
so too is it regarding the light before the tzimtzum,
which is not in the aspect of existence and its entire matter is only that it is His Name,
"He and His Name alone."

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that "length" (orech) is even higher than the pre-tzimtzum light, corresponding to the Torah, for which all worlds and even the pre-tzimtzum revelations exist.

translations.translation: Now, it is known
that in the Ein Sof light before the tzimtzum there are
(in general)
two levels.
The essence of the light and the spreading of the light.
And within the spreading of the light itself, there are two levels in general.
A revelation to itself,
which is the root of the surrounding light (Or HaSovev).
And the revelation that relates to the worlds
(for although the general light before the tzimtzum is included in His Essence as above,
nevertheless, within His Essence itself there is a revelation that relates to the worlds),
and it is the root of the filling light (Or HaMemalei).
And according to what is known,
that the drawing down of light above is not in a compulsory manner, heaven forbid,
and even the drawing down of the light before the tzimtzum
(even the revelation to itself, which is above the revelation that relates to the worlds)
is for some intention for the sake of the worlds,
it follows,
that these two aspects of Sovev and Memalei after the tzimtzum are drawn from the two revelations
(revelation to itself and revelation that relates to the worlds)
before the tzimtzum, in a manner that the revelations before the tzimtzum are related
to the aspects after the tzimtzum.
And from this it is understood,
that even the light before the tzimtzum is included in the Source of Life,
and "length" (orech)
(which is above the Source of Life)
is more elevated even than the light before the tzimtzum.
And it can be said that this is what is explained in the maamar, that "length" refers to the Torah
("Torah is light"),
for the Torah is not for the sake of the worlds,
on the contrary,
the coming-into-being of all the worlds
(including even the revelations before the tzimtzum,
which are for the sake of the worlds)
is for the sake of the Torah.
